steps.content: An indefinite length of time has passed since the initial collapse.
In the surroundings, there are only ruins and boundless darkness.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Quick, wake up, get out of here.
The young girl opens her eyes and props herself up on the rubble, struggling.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: What is... this place?
DisSea.
Before her, a blurry shadow is making some weird noise.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: That's not how DisSea looks like...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Have you forgotten?
Ice-cold memories flood the girl's mind. She kneels on the ground, tears flowing out of her gradually whitening eyes.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: The caretaker... and the doctor... They've all...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: There's no time to get sentimental. Look around you.
The girl looks around. The ruins are packed with countless bizarre creatures.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: This is...?

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Humans.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Or perhaps I should say, most of them used to be humans.
The girl takes a few steps back fearfully.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You want to live on, don't you?

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: If you don't run now, you won't get another chance.
Without a second thought, the girl follows the shadow's advice.
It's strange. Not long ago, she was still being tormented by her illness and could barely walk without the caretaker's help.
But under that blood-red moon, she's running faster and faster, as if even pain can't catch up with her anymore.
Even so, there's no time for celebration. The surrounding monsters keep multiplying, and her fear is almost overflowing from her chest.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I can't die here. I must get out...
The girl keeps running like mad, until she's coughing up blood in her breaths, until she can't feel her limbs anymore, until her heart stops, and all that remains is that small but firm will of hers.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I want to watch it once more... The sunrise...
But even the firmest will will eventually get obliterated by the cruel reality.
The run is too long, so long that the girl has forgotten how much time has passed. She finally collapses over a stretch of rubble.
This spot is not very different from her starting point.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Haha...
The shadow's hysterical laughter rings near her ears.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Hahahaha!
Lying on the ruin, the girl still keeps groveling forward, as if not hearing that irritating laughter.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You're alive, only you're alive. Why should it be you?

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You're a Sinner, yet you're so weak... If we were you...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You can't make it out on your own.
The girl's arms are slightly bent, leaving a dark red trail on the rubble.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Are you really so desperate to live on?

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Good, because we are, too.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Accept us and become our vessel... Let's continue to live together.
The girl's body freezes for a second. Then, as the endless exhaustion and darkness overwhelm her, she blacks out.

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: Somebody help me...

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: I don't want to become like that...

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: I don't want to die...
In the dim kitchen, the inhuman monster is whimpering hopelessly.
NOX raises the longsword in her hands. Her motion is too ruthless and smooth, as if she's already done this a thousand times.

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: Mom...?

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: Are you here to... pick me up...?
NOX pauses. She doesn't know why she's here and what exactly she's doing.

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: I'm all alone... I'm scared...

steps.speaker: Mutated Youngster
steps.content: I don't want to... turn into that...
Clank!
When the longsword falls on the ground, NOX's pale gray eyes are full of agony and doubts.
At that moment, the shadow that she could never get rid of, once again appears before her.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Kill him, and take him in.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Just like before.
NOX stumbles backward, not responding to the shadow's provocation.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You need to live on, like we do, so does he.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: This is... not living... at all...

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You must do it.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: We've made a promise.
The girl backs off desperately, but the shadow won't let her go.
Dark gray mist spurts out of the girl's body, tightening around her limbs.
Driven by the shadow, the girl picks up the longsword again. She's fighting it with her instinct, the longsword halting mid-swing in the air.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I... can't...
The shadow finally covers the girl's eyes. The longsword rips through the air, and the teenage boy stops crying.
Yet the girl can be heard crying in the dark.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Somebody help me...
Just like in the past, no one answers her.
The girl has lost track of time waiting in the dark.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: How strange, where am I? Why... am I here?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I should... stop them, but... on my own, I can't do anything...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Somebody help me...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Who... am I...?
In the hopeless wait, her memories are starting to dwindle. Darkness is coming near, and the girl is like ashes from the remains of a fire, gradually losing brightness.
Until a beam of light breaks up an opening on the edge of the darkness. Someone's voice rouses her.
Don't give up, I'm here!
A figure is desperately squeezing into this darkness, bringing in light that is faint yet impossible to ignore.
The light illuminates the girl's sick and extremely scrawny body, as well as the countless horrible shadows crawling all over her.
I know it's painful, but... don't give up!
You want to see the sunrise, don't you? Remember? I've promised to take you out, to see DisCity's sunrise!
I'm here to fulfill my promise!
The girl looks up mechanically at the person approaching her.
Grab my hand! We'll get out of here together!
Amber!
Amber, the name in the first line of every letter. A symbol of the morning sun and hope, it rekindles the light in those pale gray eyes.
She reaches out a hand, brilliant white light shooting out from that tattered body.

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: Nino

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: Finally... you're here.
The shadows clinging onto Amber are fleeing from her body hysterically, raucous wails shaking the entire darkness.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You can't do that, we've made a promise!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: You can't fight against DisSea on your own!

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: I don't want to die, we must stay together if we want to live!

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: But this is not living at all.

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: I want to live in earnest.

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: Even if it's just for once, I want to watch the sunrise again...

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: I've had enough of you.
Amber grips that hand.
The white light expels the darkness, and the nightmarish shadows are nowhere to be seen.
Amber gives a dazzling smile.

steps.speaker: Amber
steps.content: Let's go.
The target has... broken free... from the constraints...!
Ensure the Chief's... safety...
Unit 3... has failed...
We can't hold her off!
You wake up from the happy illusion only to find a complete chaos all over the place.
The dizziness has not completely passed. You force yourself to get up.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief...
Nightingale is usually calm, but right now her voice is filled with shock and bitterness.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: NOX destroyed the constraints, we...
We couldn't stop her.
